ValidationRule.description: Prevent credit referral case closure if the status of the assessment outcome isnt approved/declined. Case can only be closed when outcome is approved/declined and through finalisation call
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Credit_Referral", System_Action__c = false, AND( Assessment_Outcome__c <> "Approved", Assessment_Outcome__c <> "Declined" ), OR( PRIORVALUE(Status) <> "Closed - Approved", PRIORVALUE(Status) <> "Closed - Declined" ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed - Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed - Declined") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can't close this credit referral case until the loan application assessment outcome is approved or declined. Please review the case and submit for reassessment.
